name: YouTube
reason: Videos and public comments can include mature topics. This policy covers the main YouTube service, not YouTube Kids or supervised-account settings.

name: Instagram
reason: Public profiles, messages, and recommendations can bring contact and content from people you do not know.

name: TikTok
reason: WebCompass chooses a more cautious band for public short-video feeds and contact with strangers. This project rating is not TikTok's official minimum age.

name: Reddit
reason: Open communities can include mature discussions. A whole-domain rating does not filter adult posts or communities.

name: X / Twitter
reason: WebCompass chooses a more cautious band for public conversations, unpredictable feeds, and contact with strangers.

name: Facebook
reason: Public posts, groups, and messages can expose personal information and connect you with unfamiliar people.

name: Snapchat
reason: Messaging, public stories, and location features need careful privacy choices.

name: Discord
reason: Open communities and direct messages can connect you with people you do not know.

name: Twitch
reason: Live streams and public chat can include mature language and unpredictable conversations.

name: Pinterest
reason: Public image recommendations and profiles can include content intended for older audiences.
